proposal: global per-cell maximum continuous passage CREDITED scalar + only last chronological exact-endpoint tail
creditStorage: The scratch CoverageView flushes each geometric best update only after the real accumulator delta is applied, storing previous score + actually credited delta. Thus scoreSum and total telescope even with existing perpiece/perwalk caps.
reason: The inserted1m record starts during A and is already covered, so it adds0. It ends at another location and replaces the sole last-tail before B starts. A+B were formerly one joined cell passage; now the shared boundary cell is measured as two independent partial passages and only their maximum survives. The reduction also appears in the sum of final coverage scores, so this is not just a total accumulator bookkeeping issue.
